trackerLog.subject: Asteria

feature.title: Act 0 Boss — Snapfrog
feature.notes:
User lock: Snapfrog is the final Act 0 boss design. Snapping turtle + frog hybrid. Name, silhouette, and kit from the posted sheet. Prior squat blue-gray study and generated concept/sketch plates are superseded, not discarded.
Sheet lock: armored algae-covered spiked shell, monster head with wide snapping jaw and yellow eyes, powerful webbed legs, spiked mace tail. Parents: snapping turtle (bite, armored shell, thick limbs) and frog (agility, jump, swim). Action: leap and swim.
Padon / WillowDale harvest-road water. First module with FEAT-013. No game source from this chat.

trackerLog.decision: FEAT-052 final design is Snapfrog. User plate wins over the earlier text study.
